'''Łukasz Karol Albrecht''' (born [[September 5|5 Septembe]]<nowiki/>r [[1980]] in [[Łódź]]) – is a Polish professor of exact and natural sciences. He specializes in [[Enantioselective synthesis|asymmetric catalysis]] and in the synthesis and application of organic catalysts with precisely defined spatial structures.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-01-08 |title=prof. dr hab. inż. Łukasz Albrecht |url=https://p.lodz.pl/nauka/najwybitniejsi-naukowcy-w-pl/prof-dr-hab-inz-lukasz-albrecht |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=Politechnika Łódzka |language=pl}}</ref> Professionally affiliated with [[Łódź University of Technology]], he has served since 2020 as the university's Vice-Rector for Science.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2020-09-11 |title=Prorektor ds. nauki |url=https://p.lodz.pl/uczelnia/wladze/rektor-i-prorektorzy-pl/prorektor-ds-nauki |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=Politechnika Łódzka |language=pl}}</ref> He is also the Director of the [[:pl:Instytut Chemii Organicznej Politechniki Łódzkiej|Institute of Organic Chemistry]] at Łódź University of Technology.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Władze Instytutu {{!}} Instytut Chemii Organicznej - Politechnika Łódzka |url=http://chorg.p.lodz.pl/o-instytucie/wladze-instytutu |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=chorg.p.lodz.pl |language=pl}}</ref>

== Career ==
In 2004, he completed a master's degree in the chemistry of biologically important compounds under an individual course of study. In 2009, he defended his doctoral dissertation with distinction and obtained a Ph.D. in Chemical Sciences.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Ludzie Nauki |url=https://ludzie.nauka.gov.pl/ln/profiles/%C5%82ukasz.albrecht.zrsSayjTBRl |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=ludzie.nauka.gov.pl}}</ref> For his dissertation, he received the Prime Minister's Award<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nagrody Premiera - Kancelaria Prezesa Rady Ministrów - Portal Gov.pl |url=https://www.gov.pl/web/premier/nagrody-premiera |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=Kancelaria Prezesa Rady Ministrów |language=pl-PL}}</ref> and, in 2010, the Sigma-Aldrich Award and the award of the [[Polish Chemical Society]].<ref name=":0" />

After earning his doctoral degree, he became a fellow of the KOLUMB Program of the [[Foundation for Polish Science]]. He subsequently completed a postdoctoral fellowship of more than three years at [[Aarhus University]] in [[Denmark]].<ref name=":0" />

In 2015, he obtained the degree of Doctor of Science (habilitation) in Chemical Sciences,<ref name=":1" /> and in 2019 he was awarded the title of Professor of Exact and Natural Sciences.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Andrzej Duda wręczył nominacje profesorskie |url=https://www.prezydent.pl/kancelaria/archiwum/andrzej-duda/aktualnosci/nominacje/andrzej-duda-nominacje-profesorskie,7609 |access-date=2026-07-22|date=28 November 2019}}</ref> In 2020, he assumed the position of Vice-Rector for Science at Łódź University of Technology. He continues to serve in this role during the 2024–2028 term.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Łukasz Albrecht {{!}} Kongres OEES |url=https://kongres.oees.pl/lukasz-albrecht/ |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=kongres.oees.pl}}</ref>

== Research ==
He heads the Asymmetric Catalysis Research Group at the Institute of Organic Chemistry of Łódź University of Technology.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Zespół katalizy asymetrycznej {{!}} Instytut Chemii Organicznej - Politechnika Łódzka |url=http://chorg.p.lodz.pl/zespol-katalizy-asymetrycznej |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=chorg.p.lodz.pl |language=pl}}</ref> The group's research focuses on stereocontrolled organic synthesis, [[organocatalysis]], and the mechanisms of [[Catalysis|catalytic reactions]].<ref name=":2" />

Together with Anna Albrecht and Luca Dell’Amico, he co-edited the two-volume publication ''Asymmetric Organocatalysis: New Strategies, Catalysts, and Opportunities'', published by [[Wiley-VCH]].<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/book/10.1002/9783527832217 |title=Asymmetric Organocatalysis |date=2022-11-18 |publisher=Wiley |isbn=978-3-527-34907-4 |editor-last=Albrecht |editor-first=Łukasz |language=en |doi=10.1002/9783527832217 |editor-last2=Albrecht |editor-first2=Anna |editor-last3=Dell'Amico |editor-first3=Luca}}</ref>

== Organizational activity ==

* In 2024, he was elected vice-chair of the Chemistry Committee of the Polish Academy of Sciences for the 2024–2028 term.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-07-06 |title=Komitet Chemii |url=https://komchem.pan.pl/ |access-date=2026-07-22 |language=pl-PL}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-05-27 |title=Prof. Łukasz Albrecht wiceprzewodniczącym Komitetu Chemii PAN {{!}} Aktualności {{!}} Wydział Chemiczny - Politechnika Łódzka |url=https://chemia.p.lodz.pl/wydzial/aktualnosci/prof-lukasz-albrecht-wiceprzewodniczacym-komitetu-chemii-pan |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=chemia.p.lodz.pl |language=pl}}</ref>
* He serves as vice-chair of the College of Vice-Rectors for Research and Development of public technical universities.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-06-10 |title=Władze - Kolegium Prorektorów ds. Nauki i Rozwoju |url=https://kpnir.pm.szczecin.pl/wladze/ |access-date=2026-07-22 |language=pl-PL}}</ref>
* In 2024, he was appointed to the supervisory board of EIT Health InnoStars, where he represents the Polish partners of EIT Health.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-03 |title=Profesor Łukasz Albrecht z PŁ w Radzie Nadzorczej EIT Health InnoStars |url=https://p.lodz.pl/uczelnia/aktualnosci/profesor-lukasz-albrecht-z-pl-w-radzie-nadzorczej-eit-health-innostars |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=Politechnika Łódzka |language=pl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Dorota |title=Prof. Łukasz Albrecht w Radzie Nadzorczej EIT Health InnoStars - perspektywy.pl |url=https://perspektywy.pl/aktualno%C5%9Bci/wydarzenia/prof-lukasz-albrecht-w-radzie-nadzorczej-eit-health-innostars |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=perspektywy.pl |language=pl}}</ref>
* For the years 2026–2027, he was elected as Poland's National Representative in the Organic and Biomolecular Chemistry Division of the  [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|International Union of Purend Applied Chemistry]] (IUPAC).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Member Details |url=https://iupac.org/member/ |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=IUPAC {{!}} International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-14 |title=Prof. Łukasz Albrecht przedstawicielem Polski w globalnej organizacji chemicznej |url=https://p.lodz.pl/uczelnia/aktualnosci/prof-lukasz-albrecht-przedstawicielem-polski-w-globalnej-organizacji-chemicznej |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=Politechnika Łódzka |language=pl}}</ref>

* '''2022''' – [[Stanisław Kostanecki]] Medal of the Polish Chemical Society.<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022 |title=Prof. Łukasz Albrecht z PŁ odznaczony Medalem im.
